# Payments API — operations

23 operations. Full request and response shapes: [reference.md](reference.md).

- `payments.create-config` — **Create new provider config** — `POST /payments/custom-provider/connect` (write, location)
  API to create a new payment config for given location
- `payments.create-coupon` — **Create Coupon** — `POST /payments/coupon` (write, location)
  The "Create Coupon" API allows you to create a new promotional coupon with customizable parameters such as discount amount, validity period, usage limits, and applicable products.
- `payments.create-integration` — **Create new integration** — `POST /payments/custom-provider/provider` (write, location)
  API to create a new association for an app and location
- `payments.create-integration-provider` — **Create White-label Integration Provider** — `POST /payments/integrations/provider/whitelabel` (write, location)
  The "Create White-label Integration Provider" API allows adding a new payment provider integration to the system which is built on top of Authorize.net or NMI.
- `payments.create-order-fulfillment` — **Create order fulfillment** — `POST /payments/orders/{orderId}/fulfillments` (write, location)
  The "Order Fulfillment" API facilitates the process of fulfilling an order.
- `payments.custom-provider-marketplace-app-update-capabilities` — **Custom-provider marketplace app update capabilities** — `PUT /payments/custom-provider/capabilities` (write, location)
  Toggle capabilities for the marketplace app tied to the OAuth client
- `payments.delete-coupon` — **Delete Coupon** — `DELETE /payments/coupon` (write, location)
  The "Delete Coupon" API allows you to permanently remove a coupon from your system using its unique identifier.
- `payments.delete-integration` — **Deleting an existing integration** — `DELETE /payments/custom-provider/provider` (write, location)

- `payments.disconnect-config` — **Disconnect existing provider config** — `POST /payments/custom-provider/disconnect` (write, location)

- `payments.get-order-by-id` — **Get Order by ID** — `GET /payments/orders/{orderId}` (read, location)
